messages.subject: New 'deal' version
messages.body_plain:
Dear all
 
A new version of R will soon be released. For 'deal' to be compatible with the new version, I had to do some slight changes, so there is now a version 1.2-30 on CRAN (or soon will be). None of the changes are user-visible.
 
I removed the experimental interface to dynamicGraph, since this package currently is not compatible with the new R version and thus possibly will be removed. Of course, it would be possible to put the interface back in, if dynamicGraph survives.
 
To install the new version of deal, do as usual something along
 
install.packages("deal", depend=TRUE)
 
or, if you already have deal:
 
update.packages()
 
Best,
Claus
